features: Follow the system accent color on Windows and macOS.
improvements: Redesign the What's New dialog shown after an update.
fixes: Complete backups that finish with Borg warnings, such as unreadable files, instead of failing them.

improvements: Show backup progress sizes with two decimals so large backups visibly advance.
fixes: Clear a repository's previous error when a new operation starts, and ignore lock errors from background queries while a backup is running.
Fix overestimated speed and remaining time on large backups.
Wait up to 10 minutes for the repository lock left behind by a dropped SSH connection instead of failing the backup.

features: Exclude selected files and directories from new backups.
Skip iCloud placeholder files on macOS without downloading their contents.
improvements: Use the configured binary or decimal units when entering repository rate limits.
Use faster repository statistics during prune with Borg 1.4.5 or newer.
fixes: Reject unsupported Borg 2 versions before repository operations; experimental support is limited to Borg 2.0.0b21.

improvements: Keep transient window and backup timing state separate from durable configuration.
Keep one rolling configuration backup and remove legacy timestamped backups after migration.
fixes: Refresh the archive list after scheduled backups, including workflows that continue with automatic prune and compact.

features: View repository size and free storage.
Wake the computer for scheduled backups and optionally defer scheduled runs while on battery power.
improvements: Report missing remote Borg executables clearly.
Archive browser folder rows now show their total file size.
fixes: Improve scheduled backup progress, missed runs, and credential errors.
Open unencrypted repositories without a passphrase prompt.
Fix archive browser text contrast in dark theme.

improvements: App internals were reorganized for more reliable future changes.
security: Repository URLs now reject embedded passwords or secret tokens before they can be stored in config or logs.

features: Repository list: Change Passphrase action, rotates the encryption passphrase and updates the OS keychain entry.
fixes: Fix repository operations hanging when a background job threw an unhandled exception.
Fix repository being flagged with an error after cancelling the passphrase prompt.

features: Repository list: Duplicate action in the More menu, copies an existing repository's configuration under a new name.
Settings: auto-load options for archive list, repository details, and archive details.
improvements: Repository editor: save closes immediately when no connection-affecting field changed.

features: Prune tab: automatically compact the repository after prune to reclaim freed space (on by default; toggle in the Prune tab).
Repository editor: optional Archive Name Prefix field on the General tab — used as the prefix for generated archive names; falls back to the repository name when blank.
improvements: Repository editor: renamed Display Name to Repository Name.

features: Configurable log verbosity (Debug, Info, Warning, Error) in Advanced settings.
fixes: Fix shutdown log entry not being written, so logs now reliably end with a 'shutting down' line.

features: Prune: new editor tab for per-rule retention, action in the repository More menu, and option to run prune automatically after each scheduled backup.
fixes: Fix toolbar labels not retranslating when the interface language is changed.
Fix repository editor tab strip wrapping onto two rows with longer translations.
Fix OS autostart entry being rewritten on every settings save.

features: Operations on different repositories now run in parallel.
Progress indicator on repository list items during backup and other operations.
Operation errors shown in notifications instead of popup dialogs.
improvements: Repository editor verifies connection before saving.
Prevent system sleep during long-running borg operations.
fixes: Fix BorgMate blocking session logout/shutdown on Linux.
Fix crash on closing system file picker on macOS
